title: Metalliksa: open research workstation for LPBF melt-pool and process-window screening
description: Open research workstation for laser powder bed fusion (LPBF) melt-pool and process-window screening. Designed so that each result shows its source, evidence level and limits; no experimental validation is claimed. Includes P-v process-window maps, CALPHAD with the MatCalc open databases, Nb segregation/Laves literature estimates, and benchmarks against published single-track and keyhole measurements with negative results documented. Under active development (pre-1.0).
